name: qfd_coll_split_q10a-q10a-COMMIT
purpose: SQ-C2-COLL Q leaf q10a: q10a MAIN = q9a outline 248.40x276.48 + the same 3 free-standing SRAM columns / >=20-um channels; W/E 128-bit buses spread over the full face 5.4..271.08 um (66.4 um each, 1.93 signal pins/um), ordered bottom->top W sx2,sx1,sr2,sr1 / E ur,dp,dr,up so the face-anchored pin flops reach their N-face partners (od_q, ir_q) in <= 387 um (q9 order: up_data 451 um, sr1 419 um).
